review_candidates.title: Azure Cloud Platform Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Description Azure Cloud Platform Engineer Key Responsibilities Cloud Deployment and Configuration Provision, configure, and manage Azure services, including virtual machines, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), App Services, Azure SQL, Storage Accounts, and Azure Functions. Configure and maintain hybrid cloud connectivity using Azure Arc, Site-to-Site VPN, and ExpressRoute. eligibility_evidence: Configure and maintain hybrid cloud connectivity using Azure Arc, Site-to-Site VPN, and ExpressRoute.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and hybrid cloud environments.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Collaboration and Continuous Improvement Collaborate with cloud architects, application teams, security specialists, and operations teams to align technical solutions with business requirements. Qualifications And Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 4–7 years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, or related technical roles, including at least 2 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure. Hands-on experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), container platforms, and serverless services such as Azure Functions and Logic Apps. Proficiency in scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, and Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
